subject: grok-cli
title: 253 property tests exist but no CI workflow runs vitest
evidence: .github/workflows/typecheck.yml:31-41 (format/lint/typecheck/build only); release.yml has no test step; 48 src/**/*.test.ts (5,379 LOC)
one_why: Tests assert real semantics (compaction cut-points, shuru wrap escaping) yet nothing enforces them on push, so regressions merge silently — the single cheapest fix on this subject.

subject: grok-cli
title: No approval gate for bash, file writes, or MCP tools in default host mode
evidence: src/grok/tools.ts:901 (only needsApproval in tree, for paid_request); no approval path in src/tools/bash.ts or file tools
one_why: The one approval mechanism built exists solely for payments; destructive host commands run unattended by default because sandboxMode defaults to off (src/tools/bash.ts:42) and is macOS-arm64-only.

subject: grok-cli
title: Hooks loaded from user settings only, with explicit anti-repo-committed-hook rationale
one_why: Deliberately excludes repo-committed project settings so a malicious repo cannot execute unsandboxed host commands via hook definitions — a documented, copyable trust boundary.

subject: grok-cli
title: Shuru microVM sandbox is fail-closed and trust-prompted, but platform-gated and off by default
evidence: src/utils/workspace-trust.ts:23-25 (darwin+arm64 only); src/tools/bash.ts:411-413 (unsupported => error, no host fallback); src/index.ts:196-211 (default-Y first-run prompt)
one_why: Fail-closed-when-unsupported plus a default-Y per-workspace trust prompt is a stronger posture shape than nanocoder's fail-open jail, but the off default on non-Apple-Silicon guts it for most users.

subject: grok-cli
title: Context-overflow retry halves keep-recent budget down to a 4k floor
one_why: On a context-limit error with no assistant output it re-compacts more aggressively and retries once instead of dying — a small bounded recovery ladder worth lifting.

subject: grok-cli
title: x402 wallet payments with BRIN security pre-scan hard-blocking low-score URLs
evidence: src/payments/service.ts:103-123 (brin.score<25 => blocked_by_brin); src/agent/agent.ts:2043-2076 (402-header probe feeds approval prompt)
one_why: Only corpus subject with agent-initiated crypto payments; the security-scan-before-pay gate with a human approval step is the transferable pattern (scoring service itself is third-party).

subject: grok-cli
title: Telegram remote control of a live CLI session: pairing codes, voice STT, streamed previews
one_why: Driving the running agent from a phone with audio input is a distinctive interop surface no anchor or sibling subject has, though it widens the unattended-approval attack surface noted in grok-cli-2.

subject: grok-cli
title: Encrypted-reasoning marker detection hides opaque reasoning from display and summary inputs
evidence: src/agent/reasoning.ts:4-9 (PGP/AGE/encrypted_content markers); src/agent/agent.ts:1977-1986; compaction.ts:113-127 filters it from summarization
one_why: Grok returns PGP/AGE-encrypted reasoning blocks; stripping them from compaction/summary serialization avoids feeding garbage ciphertext back into summarizer prompts.

subject: grok-cli
title: agent.ts fuses interactive loop, batch loop, delegation and recap; App is 5.9k LOC
one_why: Both fusions trip the pi-errata docking rule (>5k product-surface file); loop/batch separation would make headless modes independently testable.
